_about: Words the live chat's moderator removes as hate (whole words, any case, accents and leetspeak read back: server/publish/chat/rules.js). 'extra' is for the owner's own blocked words. The same lists can go in YouTube Studio's own blocked words (docs/publishing/chat-moderation.md). Kept short and unambiguous on purpose: a word that is also an everyday word does not belong here.
